title: The Lone Stars group after AAWSAP

tellings.quote: so they formed this informal group which is called the the Lone Stars.

plain: A researcher called Jason says that after AAWSAP, a Pentagon-funded programme that studied unexplained phenomena, came to an end around 2010, some of the people involved kept going on their own. He says they formed an informal group called the Lone Stars, and he names the researchers Jacques Vallee, Eric Davis and Hal Puthoff. If so, the study of these mysteries carried on quietly after the official money stopped.
